settings.heading: Information Display
settings.description: Venustas heated apparel has changed my lifestyle because I can now be warm while I ride and train throughout the winter.

settings.heading: Q1: How do you feel about Venustas heated apparel?
settings.body: I love Venustas heated apparel. It’s so warm and easy to charge. It also gets warm really fast and stays warm throughout my hour-long lesson or practice. Being in the midwest, I really need a heated jacket. I’m really glad I picked Venustas.

settings.heading: Q2: How does Venustas heated apparel change your lifestyle?
settings.body: Venustas heated apparel has changed my lifestyle because I can now be warm while I ride and train throughout the winter. I used to have to layer up and that caused me to be stiff. Now that I have my Venustas heated jacket and the heated vest, I can ride to the best of my ability while still staying warm and being free.

settings.heading: Q3: Which part most appealing to you about Venustas?
settings.body: The most appealing thing about Venustas heated jacket and the heated vest is how the battery packs are reversible. I am so grateful that I got the heated jacket and heated vest, because I switch out the battery packs when I forget to charge the other one.

settings.heading: Q4: The reason to be our V+ Master.
settings.body: I have a unique audience being an equestrian and a paraequestrian. I can promote to other equestrians and paraequestrians how reliable and dependent the Venustas heated jacket and the heated vest are. Equestrians are always looking for heated apparel for the winter. We are usually outside anywhere from two hours to six hours at a time.
